title: Derived global sections preserves ambient quasi-coherent coproducts
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $D(\mathcal O_X)$ and its full quasi-coherent subcategory be as in [def-pc-derived-category], and let $G=R\Gamma(X,-)$ be the module-valued unbounded derived global-sections functor [def-pc-global-derived-rhom]. For any set-indexed family $(E_i)_{i\in I}$ of quasi-coherent derived objects and an ambient colimiting cofan $(S,\iota_i)$, the cofan $(G(S),G(\iota_i))$ is colimiting in $D(\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X))$.

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Put A = Γ(X,O_X) and a:X → Y=Spec A equal to X.toSpecΓ. Mathlib supplies QuasiCompact a and QuasiSeparated a from the qcqs assumptions. By [lem-pc-derived-qcoh-closed-coproducts], the given ambient colimiting cofan has quasi-coherent apex S. By [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-direct-sums], Ra_* maps this cofan to a colimiting ambient cofan on Y. By [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh], its summands and apex lie in D_QCoh(Y). The full-subcategory inclusion reflects colimits, hence this cofan is also colimiting in D_QCoh(Y).

source.place: Proposition perfect-proposition-compact-is-perfect (Tag 09M1), proof, first paragraph; structure-sheaf case

proof.text: Take the affine equivalence of [lem-pc-affine-qcoh-derived-equivalence] for A. Its inverse preserves the cofan just constructed. Its specified natural isomorphism identifies that inverse with derived global sections on Y after transport of scalars along ΓSpecIso.inv. Apply [lem-pc-derived-global-sections-affinization-comparison] to identify Ra_* followed by this functor with RΓ(X,-). IsColimit.mapCoconeEquiv transports the universal property, and Cofan.isColimitMapCoconeEquiv identifies the legs with RΓ(X,ι_i).

lean.statement:
theorem derivedGlobalSections_preserves_coproducts (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))] :
    letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (ModuleCat.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (op ⊤)))
    let G := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctor
    ∀ (I : Type u) (E : I → schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
      (S : schemeDerivedCategory X) (ι : ∀ i, (E i).obj ⟶ S),
      IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι) →
      Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (G.obj S) (fun i ↦ G.map (ι i))))
